description: Urban Water Infrastructure Investment Model (UWIIM) - Monthly version (Santa Rosa City, California) is a model listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Alonso Vicario, Sara (deposited on HydroShare). This repository contains an adapted version of the UWIIM model presented by Wiechman (2024), originally available at: The version presented here has been modified to run at monthly time steps and is parametrized for the city of Santa Rosa, California. Coverage: California, United States. The resource was created 2025-10-15 and last updated 2025-10-15; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
